findings.summary: Tuple positions and parallel user-management bindings duplicate static page/action relations.
Role home routing is separately hardcoded in WorkspaceAuthenticationService instead of projected from the static catalog.
Using historical U02's expanded active allowlist for this migration causes correct manifest-drift fail-closed behavior.

A generated-contract retirement can expose a legacy feature consumer that still calls the retired operation; a passing architecture-test-only command does not establish typecheck compatibility. The finite affected set is the retired operation's OpenAPI/generated/catalog identities, the two HeadCompanyManagementPage call sites, its P6-3 removal receipt, and the operations-admin test/typecheck scripts.
A generated runtime lookup for a source-model 1:1 relation must fail closed if a duplicate projection somehow reaches runtime, rather than silently selecting its first row.

A static-only successor package used a prose-like business-evidence obligation value that is not in the compliance controller's closed vocabulary, so package exit was mechanically uncloseable despite the approved no-dynamic boundary.
